findings.text: follow-on: imprecision (not a defect in the conclusion; the core claim holds): 'once the mask stops changing the settle test ends the loop' omits two conjuncts of the actual settled predicate — inner_result.accepted_newton_promotions == 0 and jnp.all(selected_state == state). Trip 0's mask difference is also 0 ([0,0,...]) yet the loop did not settle there because a promotion was accepted, so an unchanged mask alone is neither necessary-and-sufficient as the sentence implies. The load-bearing claim — the settle branch consults no residual — is correct.

follow-on: partition.topology.x_point is an all-NaN column (absent X-point in this absolute-current fixture); the _changed() summariser computes changed_entries with !=, so NaN != NaN reports changed_entries=2 for a uniformly absent quantity and a reader sees x_point listed as changed. The report prints nan rather than concealing it, so this is a reporting artifact, not a hidden error, but a uniformly-NaN field flagged as 'changed' is the shape the negative-control rule warns about.

raw_text: VERDICT pass (87/100; goal_fidelity 18, evidence 17, scope_discipline 19, durability 15, fit 18). The reviewed node diagnoses why the frozen-Newton route terminates at live residual 2.372871479533e-06 above the 1e-6 tolerance: the outer active-set settle branch admits termination on an unchanged mask and unchanged state with zero accepted promotions and NO residual-versus-tolerance test. I verified the mechanism in nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py at HEAD (settled predicate lines 4639-4648 has no convergence_tolerance term; converged at 4625-4628 does), verified the committed receipt is byte-identical to the reviewed run's own H200 gate log (64fdfe787, EXIT=0), and confirmed the review range f157f8419..1119fbc79 is exactly the four declared paths. The receipt's numbers are the exact signature of that branch firing (ACTIVE_SET_SETTLED, converged=False, residual 2.37e-6 > 1e-6, mask diffs [0,0], 1 accepted promotion), so the mechanism is supported; the recommended residual gate follows, qualified by the node's own honest caveat that its refresh re-freezes and so confirms no live-read pass, and by 8 further Newton steps not moving the residual. Findings: report line 60 under-states the settled predicate (mask alone is not sufficient; trip 0 also had mask diff 0); x_point is an all-NaN column whose changed_entries=2 is a NaN!=NaN artifact; and the manifest's orientation_base_sha is stale (412408ceb, not the parent of its first commit). added_failure_count null — the reviewed node ran no test suite, so there are no baseline/after arms.
residual_gate_follows: yes, conditionally qualified: gating the settle on the reconciled live relative-sup residual at or below tolerance follows directly from the mechanism and is the minimal correct fix (the partition refresh was measured not to help: frozen map equals live map to 7.105427357601e-15 and the refreshed route reproduces 2.372871479532645e-06 bit-for-bit). The qualifier the report itself records: the refresh re-freezes, so it tests a repeated frozen pass and not a live-read pass; and 8 further Newton steps on the re-frozen route do not move the residual, which is mild counter-evidence that 'continue the local Newton trajectory' alone suffices. The recommendation is therefore sound as the fix a live-read confirmation should validate, and the node lists that confirmation as a follow-on.
